```text
# #3667: CI: daily super run failed
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 42899386056](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42899386056) on `staging` (`4327b2b`, workflow_dispatch) failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [e2e component (chrome)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42899386056/job/130161274898) | failure |
| [e2e (2/8)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42899386056/job/130161275908) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: this run is on `staging`, so it is yours, and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item): production promotes itself only from a daily run on `staging` that passes every job, so it waits on this fix. The fix lands on `main` like any other, and promote-staging.yml brings it to `staging` within two hours; the next daily run there that passes promotes it, or a `/promote` on the production issue tests staging's newer commit sooner. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). A pull request's CI runs only the e2e smoke specs and leaves the tests marked `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` out, so say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._
```
